changelog:
Initial release: Full-featured Python scraper for PTT BBS (ptt.cc) public web interface.

- Supports hot board list, board categories, paginated article lists, advanced board search, single article view with exact push/boo/neutral/comments, push score breakdown, board-wide stats, and 精華區 (essence area) navigation.
- No login required; scrapes all public features available on https://www.ptt.cc.
- Returns raw, unaltered PTT post data and comments by default, with special handling for embedded copyrighted works.
- Provides a bundled script (ptt_scraper.py) covering all core commands (boards, cls, list, search, article, stats, man).
- Includes coding notes for custom extensions and best practices for scraping ptt.cc.
summary: Scrape PTT web BBS (ptt.cc) without login to fetch boards, categories, articles, comments, push/boo counts, scores, search results, and essence area data.
